set.body: Parent epic: bd-01KR8ZJJ8W882F1S9JWE06K741. Implement deterministic statistic-map kernels for one-sample t/Z and two-group t/Z. Support Welch by default and pooled variance explicitly. These kernels operate on the image matrix contract and return mask-space vectors plus volume reconstruction metadata. Tests: match base R t.test / manual Welch and pooled calculations voxel-by-voxel on tiny fixtures.
set.title: Scale-space: one-sample and two-sample statistic kernels
